I told Marcus in his #north-team thread that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November.

That date comes from Ilse's post in #north-team on 14 Oct. Marcus is a member of that channel, so he can see it too. Nothing posted there since has changed it. A renewal date is an account detail rather than a finance figure, so it was fine to share with the North team. The shared files he can read have no Brackenwater contract or account folder, so I couldn't check the date against one.
